<?php
/**
 * Live Preview only (SPEC-024 amendment 1): WP-Cron does not run in the
 * browser Playground, so Tracefern Image Check for C2PA's own queue runs on
 * admin page loads when it is due. Nothing else runs; nothing is sent.
 */
add_action('admin_init', static function (): void {
    $next = wp_next_scheduled('tracefern_check');
    if ($next !== false && $next <= time()) {
        do_action('tracefern_check');
    }
});

<?php
// One byte of image data changed: the first IDAT chunk's 100th data byte,
// with that chunk's CRC recomputed, as tamperedOpenAiPng() in tests/Pest.php.
$bytes = file_get_contents('/tmp/tracefern-demo/openai-20260826-c2pa_2x.png');
$chunk = strpos($bytes, 'IDAT') - 4;
$length = unpack('N', substr($bytes, $chunk, 4))[1];
$data = $chunk + 8;
$bytes[$data + 100] = chr(ord($bytes[$data + 100]) ^ 0x01);
$bytes = substr_replace($bytes, pack('N', crc32(substr($bytes, $chunk + 4, 4 + $length))), $data + $length, 4);
file_put_contents('/tmp/tracefern-demo/openai-20260826-c2pa_2x-altered.png', $bytes);
